en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a bust of Emperor Trajan set atop a tall pedestal in a park, with trees framing the monument and a building in the background. The pedestal bears the inscription "IMPERATULUI TRAIAN." The reverse side reads "CARTE POȘTALĂ" and identifies the subject as the Statue of Emperor Trajan in Turnu Severin, with multilingual captions and Romanian publisher details.
